canonical_terms.family_path_stage: The stable progression position inside the Family topic. Stages may later recur in a broader learning path without changing lesson IDs.
canonical_terms.session_depth: The amount of lesson content licensed for the active source-to-target language pair. Values are core or cultural.

session_depth.resolver: cultural only when BOTH learning_from and learning language are in full_target_languages; otherwise core
session_depth.tier3_policy: A Tier 3 language in either role forces core. Do not expose cultural analysis synthesized for only the other side of the pair.

stages.objective_en: Recognize and name the people in an immediate family or household while learning that languages divide kin relationships differently.

preferred_ingestion_target.title: Brother and Sister
preferred_ingestion_target.author: Josephine Lawrence
preferred_ingestion_target.reason: A child-focused sibling and household story with unusually direct repetition of beginner family relationships.

stages.objective_en: Use short, flexible patterns to describe family, household, age relationships, names, and who someone lives with without assuming one family shape.

reading.focus: father/daughter roles and simple descriptions of people in a household

preferred_ingestion_target.title: Little Women
preferred_ingestion_target.author: Louisa May Alcott
preferred_ingestion_target.reason: A family-centered story with four sisters, their mother and father, and abundant material for describing relatives and household relationships.

stages.objective_en: Name grandparents, aunts, uncles, cousins, nieces, nephews, grandchildren, great-relatives, and in-laws while noticing distinctions such as family side, age, gender, and affinity.

preferred_ingestion_target.title: Eight Cousins
preferred_ingestion_target.author: Louisa May Alcott
preferred_ingestion_target.reason: The story is explicitly built around a large extended family of cousins, aunts, and an uncle/guardian.

stages.objective_en: Talk neutrally about dating, partners, engagement, marriage, separation, divorce, former partners, widowhood, and being single.

preferred_ingestion_target.title: The Courtship of Susan Bell
preferred_ingestion_target.author: Anthony Trollope
preferred_ingestion_target.reason: A relatively accessible public-domain courtship story with family, engagement, and marriage language.

sequencing.future_policy: The global curriculum may interleave other lessons or readings between stages later. family_path_stage remains topic progression metadata, not a promise that these four always stay adjacent.
